Name: Haley dialogue for The Stardew Squad
Author: Isaldae
Description:
[size=6][b]Haley's Squad Dialogue[/b][/size]
A content pack for [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url][/b] that gives Haley her own voice when she's tagging along with you!

[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
Haley's tone changes based on how she feels about you, so her dialogue is split into three tiers:
[list]
[*][b]Low hearts:[/b] She's tolerating you and the countryside, at best.[/*]
[*][b]High hearts (6+):[/b] She's opened up. She brings her camera and is genuinely happy to be adventuring with you.[/*]
[*][b]Spouse:[/b] Warm, affectionate, grew to enjoy farm life. Among other things, she'll talk about her new cake recipes.[/*]
[/list]She has unique lines for just about every task your Squad can do:
[list]
[*]Recruiting and dismissing her[/*]
[*]Walking around with you (with location-specific dialogue!)[/*]
[*]Fighting monsters[/*]
[*]Chopping trees, mining rocks, foraging, and harvesting[/*]
[*]Watering crops[/*]
[*]Fishing[/*]
[*]Petting animals[/*]
[*]Rejection lines if you try to recruit her before she likes you enough.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]🇨🇳 Chinese - by passersby10086[/*]
[*]🇫🇷 French - by ThaliaFawnheart[/*]
[*]🇯🇵 Japanese - by OSHIKAWA[/*]
[*]🇰🇷 Korean - by snowstreet12[/*]
[*]🇵🇹 Portuguese - by NiveKTW[/*]
[/list]If you'd like to contribute a translation, send it my way and I'll add it in a future update!

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]NPC retextures:[/b] Compatible.[/*]
[*][b]Other Haley dialogue mods for The Stardew Squad[/b]: Might conflict and override one another, unless both mods are purposefully compatible with one another.[/*]
[*][b]Dialogue mods outside of The Stardew Squad, or for other characters in TSS:[/b] Compatible.

[/*]
[/list]
